strings.config.title: Unified PKM MCP Server
strings.config.description: Configure the external runtimes and Agent integrations used by Personal Knowledge Manager.
strings.config.componentVersions: Server runtime, generated schemas, and Agent Skill Router are versioned independently.
strings.config.availableEverywhereDescription: The extension registers pkm directly with VS Code; no project MCP configuration is needed. Remove old workspace pkm, pkm-chat, and pkm-chat-live entries to avoid duplicates.
strings.config.userConfigFallbackDescription: This VS Code version cannot accept extension-provided MCP definitions. Add the generated pkm entry once with MCP: Open User Configuration.
strings.config.pythonValidDescription: This machine-specific interpreter will be used for PKM MCP configuration.
strings.config.pythonSelectDescription: Select or install Python first. PKM itself remains available.
strings.config.runtimeDedicatedDescription: The unified pkm server uses this dedicated environment.
strings.config.runtimeCreateDescription: Create the runtime before generating MCP configuration.
strings.config.whyIntro: Without MCP you copy-paste context into every chat, and whatever the AI learns is lost when the session ends. With it, your assistant can:
strings.config.whySearchDescription: your skills, notes, and scripts, so it answers with your conventions and past solutions.
strings.config.whyWriteDescription: new learnings through PKM tools, turning your store into durable memory that grows across sessions.
strings.config.whyChatDescription: through the chat tools exposed by the same pkm server.
strings.config.whySyncDescription: it reads the same store this extension writes, and every change is git-tracked.
strings.config.definitionAutomatic: The extension provides this definition automatically in every workspace.
strings.config.definitionManual: Merge this entry once into MCP: Open User Configuration, preserving other servers.
strings.config.definitionCommand: The command always uses the managed runtime's absolute Python path:
strings.config.restartServer: Run MCP: List Servers, select pkm, then Start/Restart. Remote SSH windows use the provider and paths from the remote extension host.
strings.config.setupStepGenerate: Click Generate Server to create the unified server files.
strings.config.setupStepInstall: Install the required fastmcp and websockets dependencies.
strings.config.setupStepPublish: The extension publishes pkm to every workspace automatically.
strings.config.setupStepStart: Use MCP: List Servers to start it.
strings.config.agencyDescription: The extension cannot reliably inspect an external Agency registry. If pkm is not registered there, copy these current-machine instructions into Copilot or Agency. The resolved paths let the agent register the single pkm entry and verify its unified tool surface.
strings.config.registrationDetail: VS Code provider is available; verify external Agency separately
strings.config.routerTargetHelpStart: Choose any Agent Skills root. PKM creates
strings.config.routerTargetHelpEnd: Windows drive, UNC, user-home, and environment-variable paths are supported on their matching host.
strings.config.onDemandHelp: Stdio MCP servers start when an MCP client requests pkm; use MCP: List Servers to start it manually.

strings.githubSync.extensionUpgradeRequired: This Knowledge repository requires Personal Knowledge Manager {required} or newer. Installed version: {installed}. Upgrade the extension before syncing; no local content was changed.
strings.experience.tourWelcomeBody: This tour points to the real controls you will use. Nothing is changed unless you choose an action.
strings.experience.tourWorkspacesBody: Use this rail to move between Knowledge, Tools, Automation, Projects, and Settings. The tabs beside it change with each workspace.
strings.experience.tourKnowledgeBody: Skills, Notes, and Research are durable Markdown Knowledge. Search, organize, edit, and link them here.
strings.experience.tourCreateBody: This button follows the active collection. Here it creates a Skill; in Notes or Research it creates that item type instead. On a narrow panel, find it under More (…).
strings.experience.tourAutomationBody: Agent Sessions remember the user goal. Recipes provide the executable steps, evidence, recovery, and reusable experience.
strings.experience.tourProjectsBody: Projects hold plans and task context. Threads connect people and Agents without turning chat history into the source of truth.
strings.experience.tourSettingsBody: Settings owns the MCP runtime, Skill Router, subscriptions, GitHub Sync, and background work.
strings.experience.tourMcpBody: General & MCP shows whether the runtime is healthy and gives you the exact repair or generation action when setup is incomplete.
strings.experience.tourDoneBody: Use the question-mark button whenever you want to replay this tour. The sparkle button reopens the current version highlights.
strings.experience.whatsNewBody: This appears once after each installed version so important capabilities are not hidden from you.
strings.experience.whatsNewKnowledgeBody: Stable identities and links now keep Knowledge reliable across moves, migration, retrieval, and publication.
strings.experience.whatsNewWorkflowBody: Agent Sessions and Recipes now preserve goals, execution steps, evidence, recovery, and reusable experience.
strings.experience.whatsNewSafetyBody: GitHub publications declare their minimum Extension version, and an older Extension will never overwrite a newer PKM runtime.
